verdict.rationale: Factory is an agent platform with a public API (sessions API, OpenAPI spec), so issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions API keys, tokens, or per-agent credential scoping. Tiered autonomy in droid exec governs which operations can run without confirmation, and "scoped tasks" refers to task delegation; neither is about least-privilege credentials, so neither counts here.
